negative_findings.description: No Kosovo commercial bank publishes a Basel Pillar-3 style public disclosure document ('shpalosja e informatave', 'Pillar 3') that I could locate. Searches in sq and en returned only EU/Turkish bank Pillar-3 reports and CBK material.
negative_findings.result_summary: Zero Kosovo-bank Pillar-3 documents found; the cell's 'pillar-3/disclosure documents' assumption does not hold for XK.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Risk-weighted, standardised disclosure tables that would give comparable per-bank operational data do not exist here; the collection design must rely on narrative annual reports plus audited IFRS notes instead.

negative_findings.description: Serbian-language ('sr') disclosure by individual Kosovo commercial banks was not found. Serbian-language queries using 'godišnji izveštaj', 'bankomati', 'POS terminali' returned only the Central Bank of Kosovo's own Serbian editions, not bank-level reports.
negative_findings.result_summary: Bank-level sr-language reporting appears absent; banks publish in sq and en only.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: sr-language monitoring for this cell should be pointed at CBK/aggregate publishers, not at the commercial banks; expecting sr bank sources would produce false negatives in coverage scoring.

negative_findings.description: Ziraat Bank Kosova's corporate site surfaced no annual-report or financial-statements section in sq or en searching; only branch locations and product pages were found.
negative_findings.result_summary: Smallest banks in the market may not self-publish reports at all.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Per-institution coverage of the cell will be incomplete at the tail; those banks must be covered via CBK aggregates or the business registry, and the gap should be recorded rather than treated as a crawl failure.

negative_findings.description: bkt-ks.com returned 'unable to verify the first certificate' on two separate paths, and the ProCredit sq annual-reports path returned HTTP 404 while the EN equivalent served fine.
negative_findings.result_summary: Two fetch failures that are almost certainly TLS-config and URL-rename issues, not dead sources — search engines index recent documents from both domains.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A naive liveness check would mark BKT Kosova (a systemic bank) as dead and drop the highest-value domestic disclosure from the corpus.

negative_findings.description: Only TEB's report was directly text-extracted in this run and it did carry hard operational figures (POS terminals 5,593; branches 34 vs 30). It was NOT confirmed that Raiffeisen, ProCredit, NLB, BKT, BPB or Banka Ekonomike state ATM/POS/card counts in their reports — that remains a hypothesis for the extraction pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: One of seven bank report archives verified to contain the target metrics.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Usefulness scores for the un-extracted archives are structural expectations, not evidence; the extraction pass should confirm per-bank before the corpus is treated as a per-institution ATM/POS panel.

coverage_gaps.description: Not every licensed Kosovo bank had its own report archive located in this run — Ziraat Bank Kosova and any remaining smaller/foreign-branch institutions are unresolved, and Banka Ekonomike's current annual-report PDF path was not pinned down (only its indicators page and a 2003 legacy PDF).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate the licensed-bank roster from CBK's register and FSDK's member list, then run a per-bank site-structure discovery pass rather than keyword search, recording 'no archive published' explicitly where true.

coverage_gaps.description: Per-bank card portfolio size (cards issued by type) and acquiring POS-terminal counts are confirmed only for TEB; ATM counts are stated in marketing prose for Raiffeisen ('over 160') and otherwise only implicitly enumerable from locator pages.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build two complementary collectors: (a) PDF text extraction with an sq/en metric lexicon (bankomat/ATM, terminale POS, kartela/kartelat, degë, përdorues të e-banking); (b) quarterly locator-page snapshots to count ATM POIs per bank as an independent series.

coverage_gaps.description: Most banks in the cell publish annually only; NLB is the exception with quarterly/interim statements already posted into 2026, and BKT's Albanian parent publishes periodic consolidated reports.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Set differentiated crawl cadences — quarterly for nlb-kos.com and bkt.com.al, annual (Apr-Jun window) for the rest, since observed publication dates cluster in April-June.

coverage_gaps.description: No sr-language commercial-bank disclosure identified; sq and en are the working languages of this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Reallocate sr-language monitoring effort in this workstream to CBK/aggregate publishers and Serbian-language Kosovo media, and mark bank-level sr coverage as structurally unavailable rather than missing.

coverage_gaps.description: Reports use inconsistent formats and metric definitions across banks (TEB reports a total POS terminal figure; others may report only branch counts or narrative digital-adoption claims), and file naming is unstable (BPB serves a generic 'Raporti-Vjetor.pdf').
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Normalise at extraction time into a per-bank/per-year schema with an explicit 'metric not disclosed' state, and content-hash PDFs to detect silent republication under the same filename.

brief: Kosovo's commercial banks are, for this cell, a small and enumerable publisher set — roughly eight to ten licensed institutions, of which seven maintain their own web-published report archives (Raiffeisen 2010-2025, ProCredit 2013-2025, NLB 2012-2026 including quarterly interims, TEB, BKT Kosova, BPB and Banka Ekonomike). Disclosure quality is uneven but the upside is real: TEB's 2024 annual report was text-extracted in this run and states a total of 5,593 POS terminals and 34 branches (up from 30), exactly the per-institution granularity the CBK publishes only in aggregate. There is no Pillar-3 layer in Kosovo and no Serbian-language bank-level reporting, so the corpus is sq/en narrative annual reports plus audited IFRS notes, usefully supplemented by branch/ATM locator pages as an independent, higher-frequency count of network size. Practical collection risks are technical rather than legal: bkt-ks.com presents an unverifiable TLS chain and ProCredit's Albanian path has been renamed, both of which would be misread as dead sources by a naive liveness check.
